# fiberai — llms.txt

> Official Python SDK for Fiber AI. Search companies and people,
> enrich contacts, reveal work emails and phones, build audiences, and
> run AI-powered research — auto-generated from the OpenAPI spec.

**Canonical agent-facing docs live on the API, not in this repo:**

- Routing index + critical rules: https://api.fiber.ai/llms.txt
- Per-operation markdown (100+ operations):
  https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/index.md
- Any operation: `https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/<operationId>.md`
  e.g. https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/companySearch.md
- Raw OpenAPI spec: https://api.fiber.ai/openapi.json
  (supports `Accept: text/markdown` for the agent-friendly variant)
- Full corpus (concatenated, ~270 KB): https://api.fiber.ai/llms-full.txt

This SDK is a typed surface for the exact same operations documented at
those URLs. If you are an agent and you need to pick between operations
(e.g. sync vs turbo vs exhaustive contact enrichment), read
`/llms.txt` and the relevant per-operation page first — they contain
the routing policy, prerequisites, pitfalls, and quality checks that
are NOT in this README.

## Install

```bash
pip install fiberai
```

Requires Python 3.9+.

## Minimum viable snippet

```python
import os
from fiberai import Client
from fiberai.api.search import company_search
from fiberai.models import CompanySearchBody

client = Client(base_url="https://api.fiber.ai")

companies = company_search.sync(
    client=client,
    body=CompanySearchBody.from_dict({
        "apiKey": os.environ["FIBER_API_KEY"],
        "searchParams": {"industriesV2": {"anyOf": ["Software"]}},
        "pageSize": 10,
    }),
)
```

### Contact reveal (email + phone from a LinkedIn URL)

The Python SDK has not yet been regenerated against the current
public `syncQuickContactReveal` / `syncTurboContactEnrichment`
operations. Two options until the next release:

1. Call the endpoint directly with `httpx`:

   ```python
   import os
   import httpx

   with httpx.Client(base_url="https://api.fiber.ai", timeout=60.0) as client:
       response = client.post(
           "/v1/contact-details/single",
           json={
               "apiKey": os.environ["FIBER_API_KEY"],
               "linkedinUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/example",
           },
       )
       response.raise_for_status()
       print(response.json())
   ```

2. Use the MCP server (`https://mcp.fiber.ai/mcp/v2` or
   `https://mcp.fiber.ai/mcp/v3`) so the operation is exposed as a typed
   tool to your agent.

See `https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/syncQuickContactReveal.md` and
`https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/syncTurboContactEnrichment.md` for the
schema.

## Most-used operations (link to full per-op docs)

### Search
- [`companySearch`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/companySearch.md) — companies by industry / location / funding / headcount
- [`peopleSearch`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/peopleSearch.md) — people by title / seniority / department

### Live enrichment (single LinkedIn URL → real-time LinkedIn data)
- [`profileLiveEnrich`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/profileLiveEnrich.md)
- [`companyLiveEnrich`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/companyLiveEnrich.md)

### Contact enrichment (LinkedIn URL → email + phone). Pick by cost / speed / coverage:
- [`syncQuickContactReveal`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/syncQuickContactReveal.md) — standard sync, balanced
- [`syncTurboContactEnrichment`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/syncTurboContactEnrichment.md) — premium sync, fastest
- [`triggerExhaustiveContactEnrichment`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/triggerExhaustiveContactEnrichment.md) + [`pollExhaustiveContactEnrichmentResult`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/pollExhaustiveContactEnrichmentResult.md) — async waterfall, maximum coverage
- [`startBatchContactDetails`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/startBatchContactDetails.md) + [`pollBatchContactDetails`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/pollBatchContactDetails.md) — 10–2,000 identifiers

### Audiences (durable filterable list lifecycle)
- [`createAudience`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/createAudience.md) →
  [`updateAudienceSearchParams`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/updateAudienceSearchParams.md) →
  [`buildAudience`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/buildAudience.md) →
  [`estimateEnrichmentCost`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/estimateEnrichmentCost.md) →
  [`triggerEnrichment`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/triggerEnrichment.md) →
  [`exportProspects`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/exportProspects.md)

### Utility
- [`getOrgCredits`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/getOrgCredits.md) — check balance before spending
- [`getRateLimits`](https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/getRateLimits.md) — current per-operation caps

## Authentication

Pass `apiKey` in the request body of every call. Get one at
https://fiber.ai/app/api. Keys start with `sk_live_` (production) or
`sk_test_` (sandbox).

## Rate limits, credits, cost notes

- Credit cost and rate limit are stamped on every operation's per-op
  markdown page at https://api.fiber.ai/ai-docs/<operationId>.md.
- Call `get_org_credits.sync(...)` before kicking off any batch larger
  than ~50.
- Respect `Retry-After` on 429 — back off exponentially from 5s.

## MCP

If you want your agent to call Fiber operations as tools instead of
via this SDK, use the MCP server:

- V2 (auto-generated direct tools, API key): `https://mcp.fiber.ai/mcp/v2`
- V3 (direct tools over every public operation, OAuth / SSO): `https://mcp.fiber.ai/mcp/v3`
- Core (5 meta-tools over every public operation): `https://mcp.fiber.ai/mcp`

Setup: https://github.com/fiber-ai/mcp and
https://docs.fiber.ai/article/using-mcp-in-llms
